verdict.rationale: Pinecone's security docs cover managing API key permissions in the console, role-based access control over resources, service accounts, SSO, and audit logs of user and API actions. Together these deliver the API-key and role parts of the story. Nothing shows permissions scoped to individual indexes or namespaces; the namespace-per-tenant guidance describes data isolation, not access control. Missing for 10: documented per-index/per-namespace permission scoping, detail on which roles and permissions exist for data-plane operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
